# Pact

Pact is a Slack accountability app that turns workplace promises into tracked,
two-way commitments. Both participants see the pact, receive reminders, and can
close or renegotiate it without leaving Slack.

Primary URL: https://makepact.co
Support: hello@makepact.co

## Core workflows

- `/pact [commitment] by [date]` — create a pact in a direct message with a teammate
- `/pacts` — list active pacts in the current conversation
- `/done` — complete one or more active pacts
- `/pact edit [id] [text]` — edit a pact description
- `/pact extend [id] to [date]` — request a new deadline
- React to a message with 🤝 — start a pact from that message
- Use the “Make this a Pact” message shortcut
- Message the Pact bot with `help`, `my pacts`, `done`, or a dated commitment

Pact also provides automatic reminders, daily and weekly digests, recurring pacts,
two-way reschedule proposals, bulk Home Tab actions, completion streaks, and a
workspace pulse for eligible teams.

## Access

Pact is free. Every feature is included with unlimited pacts and no credit card.

## Installation

1. Visit https://makepact.co
2. Select “Add to Slack”
3. Approve the requested Slack permissions
4. Open the welcome DM or App Home

## Slack data access

Pact requests only the scopes listed in its Slack app configuration. It receives
slash commands, direct messages sent to the bot, configured app events, and message
content required for 🤝 reaction capture. When AI features are enabled, limited message
snippets may be sent to Anthropic for inference as described in the Privacy Policy.

## Integrations

Optional tracker integrations support Linear, Notion, and Asana. Each connection
is user-initiated and can be disconnected from Pact settings.

## FAQ

Q: Is Pact free?
A: Yes. Every feature is free, with unlimited pacts.

Q: Can Pact track solo commitments?
A: The bot DM can track self-directed commitments; teammate DMs provide two-way accountability.

Q: Does Pact read every Slack message?
A: No. Pact receives content through its configured commands, direct messages, events,
and reaction/shortcut workflows. Optional AI processing occurs only when those features are enabled.

Q: Which AI provider does Pact use?
A: The code integrates directly with Anthropic when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is configured.

Q: Where is Pact hosted?
A: The application runs on Vercel and stores application data in Neon PostgreSQL.
